𝐀𝐃𝐕𝐈𝐒𝐎𝐑𝐘: 𝐑𝐄𝐕𝐈𝐒𝐄𝐃 𝐏𝐎𝐒𝐒𝐈𝐁𝐋𝐄 𝐑𝐎𝐓𝐀𝐓𝐈𝐎𝐍𝐀𝐋 𝐁𝐑𝐎𝐖𝐍𝐎𝐔𝐓𝐒
📅 𝐃𝐀𝐈𝐋𝐘 | 𝐒𝐄𝐏𝐓𝐄𝐌𝐁𝐄𝐑 𝟑-𝟔, 𝟐𝟎𝟐𝟔
⏰ 𝟏𝟎:𝟎𝟎𝐀𝐌–𝟏𝟏:𝟎𝟎𝐏𝐌
Due to the current power supply situation and higher power reduction requirements, changes will be made to the previously announced rotational brownout schedule. A 𝟐.𝟓-𝐡𝐨𝐮𝐫𝐬 𝐫𝐨𝐭𝐚𝐭𝐢𝐨𝐧𝐚𝐥 𝐛𝐫𝐨𝐰𝐧𝐨𝐮𝐭 may be implemented in selected areas during periods of high demand to help manage power supply and maintain grid stability.
To help our customers prepare, please refer to the possible rotational brownout schedule for the week. Implementation will depend on prevailing grid conditions and the latest instructions from the National Grid Corporation of the Philippines (NGCP) and may be adjusted as needed.
